fields.Name: T195 - Admin ERD Details Field Type Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the entity-details field-category filter (setFieldFilter all/keys/foreign_keys/regular) — a bespoke metadata field classifier unique to the ERD details panel.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the ERD viewer. Wait for the diagram to render (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). Click any entity node to open its details panel on the right, and expand the 'Fields' accordion section. Inside the expanded Fields section header there is a small filter button group: All, Keys, FKs, Regular. Click 'Keys' (and optionally 'FKs'), then click 'All' again. Success is that the field list RESPONDS to each filter — the set of listed fields narrows when you pick Keys/FKs and returns to the full list on All (or shows a valid empty subset if that entity has none of that kind). Seeing the field list respond is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: An entity's details panel opens with an expandable Fields section containing All / Keys / FKs / Regular filter buttons
Selecting a filter narrows the displayed fields accordingly (and All restores the full list), or a valid empty subset is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
